Swept and not assigned to Events: EditorWindow::closeEvent (src/qt/EditorWindow.cpp:2529-2560). Qt delivers the request. The handler ignores close if a child refuses (2531), ConfirmSave is canceled (2535), or ProjectsWithUnsavedPoints refuses (2537-2542). The installer path is gated by m_UpdateExitPending (2550), not by m_LaunchInstaller being set. If LaunchInstallerAndExit returns false, the handler clears the pending flag, normalizes the phase only when it is still UpdateReady, restores drawing presentation, and ignores the close (2550-2558); an update launch failure can leave the phase Failed. It accepts the close when no update exit is pending or the launch succeeds. GoSurveyEditor coordinates child/tab/save workflow; Commands owns ProjectsWithUnsavedPoints; QSettings geometry/state persistence is Qt. LaunchInstallerAndExit starts the Network/update installer path but does not itself exit the process.

Swept and not assigned to Events: EditorWindow::nativeEvent (src/qt/EditorChrome.cpp:128-225). Qt invokes this GoSurveyEditor window adapter for Windows messages. Native hit-test/minmax and WM_NCCALCSIZE use Win32 message handling. WM_ENTERSIZEMOVE/WM_EXITSIZEMOVE call EditorWindow::BeginInteractiveResize/EndInteractiveResize, which invoke EditorViewport resize-preview operations rather than Win32 APIs. Windows supplies the OS/IPC contract; this app-level external-open ingress is OS-specific and not a toolkit-neutral Events publisher.
